The '''''Tormentor''''' was an [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] that was scheduled to meet a supply convoy (four [[BFF-1 bulk freighter/Legends|BFF-1 bulk freighters]] of group ''[[Monru]]'') at [[Udnil II]] during [[Operation: Clean Sweep|Imperial Operation: Clean Sweep]]. The supply operation [[Battle of Udnil II|came under attack]] by [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] forces consisting of [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wings]], [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and [[A-wing]]s as backup. At the time, the ''Tormentor'' was not carrying its standard complement of starfighters. Instead, it deployed [[TIE/ad starfighter|TIE Avengers]] to intercept the attack.

==Behind the scenes==
While the occurrence of the space battle depicted in this mission, as well as the participants, is [[canon]], the outcome depends on the actions of the player. This article therefore does not assume the battle's outcome.
